text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooooh...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't Flower-chan's running incredible?! 
What was with that sharpness! It's 
completely different from the Oaks!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Running so well in the Sprinters Stakes in 
her Classic Year... That's truly amazing! 
Flower-chan is the greatest sprinter!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —The greatest sprinter...!

‘There has to be a stage where I can shine 
even brighter.’

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Trainer... It was true.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
("Here" was the place where I could truly 
shine, wasn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(If I can shine really bright right 
here... If I can leave behind tons of 
wonderful results...!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(――I wonder if I can give Trainer the 
title of "Best Trainer" too!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew...! I have to get... even faster...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oho! Is that a declaration of rivalry?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-san, Zephyr-san...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I am perfecting my speed! As 
long as your legs are fast enough, you can 
win at any distance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So if Flower-san intends to keep pushing 
her speed to the absolute limit into the 
Senior year...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"We are going from class rep and student 
to rivals!! Or rather, we already are!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, we're rivals!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. The ones who would block the 
wind's path would be Bakushin O-san... and 
you, Flower-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My rivals, and the "wall" that stood 
before— I shall become a tempest and tear 
them all down...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...? Thank you...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—And then, I promised both Bakushin O-san 
and Zephyr-san that we'd run together 
again!

On the way back, Nishino Flower's eyes 
sparkled as she talked about the race.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! Very much so...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because you believed in me so much, 
Trainer, I was able to run at full power 
until the very end.
choice_data_list: This is the fruit of your own hard work
That's the fruit of your own hard work.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Above all, I think it's all thanks to 
your hard work, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Even today, if it had been before, I 
think I would've gotten a lot more tired."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, up until now, Trainer-san has 
always looked out for my health. That's 
why...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So, I...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um...! Moving forward, I want to keep 
doing my best at short distances!
choice_data_list:
Alright, shall we take on the sprint 
division?

text_block_list.text:
Right now in sprints and miles, Daitaku 
Helios from the older generation is 
thriving. She's a formidable opponent as 
well.

I hear she plans to run in the Mile 
Championship next. It seems Yamanin Zephyr 
is heading there as well.

Today, however, convinced me beyond doubt 
that Nishino Flower performs at her 
absolute best in sprints. Which means—
choice_data_list:
Why don't we challenge the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen next?

Why don't we challenge the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen next?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! A GⅠ, right? Yes, I want to take it on!
choice_data_list: Are you used to GⅠ races by now?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I'm still nervous, but... I'm 
looking forward to it much more than 
before.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You don't look scared at all anymore 
either, do you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, I didn't mean to tease you! Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I was just thinking about how much we've 
truly grown compared to before."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's take on plenty of challenges in the 
Senior Year too! I'm counting on you from 
here on out!

And so, crossing over into the next year, 
the next goal was set: the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ――... "Sowing seeds," done. Yep, all good.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Poppy, please bloom into wonderful 
flowers when spring comes, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to make you happy too, Trainer. 
I'll do my very, very best!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Phew... Today was a wonderful day. I 
think I'll have some sweet dreams 
tonight♪)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon, may I turn off the lights?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right on time as always. Good 
night...—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ouch...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ugh, my joints...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Is it because I'm tired?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I need to get plenty of sleep so I can do 
my best for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!)
